grading_system.evidence: Learning a diploma from RU means that students have demonstrated proficiency in our graduation standards. Pathways toward proficiency typically involve a blend of common/required experiences

schedule.evidence: In a normal school year, one common expectation is that all students are expected to carry 7 courses each semester. Block/period pattern is not stated.

credit_definition.text: Credit is awarded for semester courses; courses are labelled 'Full Year Course' or 'Semester Course'. The catalog states no per-course credit value, so credit per course-term is not stated.
credit_definition.evidence: awarding credit for all semester courses. To be promoted from one grade/class to another

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: 7 courses each semester in a normal school year (expectation); promotion counts of 4, 9, 14 and 20 full-year courses at the end of grades 9-12
course_load.evidence: all students are expected to carry 7 courses each semester. This typically includes the pathway requirements listed below.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: No graduation total is stated. Common pathway requirements are given in full years: English 4, Mathematics 3, Science 3, US History 1, Social Studies 2, Physical Education 1.5, Health/Life Skills 0.5/0.5, Fine Arts 1, World Languages (standards met through multiple pathways), plus the Senior Project. Full-year equivalents cannot be converted to credits without a stated rule.

flexible_pathways_listed: early college (Vermont State Colleges, CCV, Norwich University)
dual enrollment at Vermont State Colleges and CCV (two college courses tuition-free)
Community High School Program at Dartmouth College
notes: Proficiency-based graduation: content-area standards (Foundational Knowledge & Skills) and Habits of Community & Work transferable skill standards (p.3). Senior Project required (six parts: proposal, paper, product of at least 30 hours, portfolio, display, defense) (pp.6, 11). Students entering RTCC must have completed set course counts before senior year (p.47). Catalog year is SY 2026-27. Promotion counts are not graduation requirements. The phase2 graduation_requirements block lists 'Life Skills 0.5' separately from Health; the catalog states them as 'Health/Life Skills 0.5/0.5 years'. World Languages: standards addressed through pathways, no fixed credit count (p.6).
